title: ZoomIt activates on AltGr+key instead of Ctrl+key

status.label: Existing upstream fix
status.detail: Open PR 51383 addresses AltGr-character hotkey collisions; the prior hook-replacement design is no longer offered.

next_action.label: Review PR 51383
next_action.reason: The current upstream implementation takes a narrower approach than the historical independent design.

judgment.rationale: This remains a real typing-blocking bug, now covered by an open PR explicitly closing it. Do not approve or implement the older physical-modifier-hook design in parallel.
evidence: All 18 comments include French, German and Nordic AltGr collisions through PowerToys 0.101.2362, including the October 12 DemoMirror report.
The discussion distinguishes automatically derived Ctrl+Alt recording/mirroring shortcuts from Ctrl-only behavior and documents workarounds, not a product fix.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/51383 is OPEN and explicitly closes 37143; it skips registrations that collide with AltGr characters on installed layouts.
The existing public design trace https://github.com/MuyuanMS/PowerToys/issues/647 remains open but does not justify competing implementation.
judgment.recommended_action: Review PR 51383 and its layout/registration coverage; preserve the old fork trace as history without an approve-design action.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR 51383 covers the reported AltGr collisions. It intentionally skips colliding hotkeys rather than introducing the broader hook/settings redesign previously drafted here.

issue_context.summary: ZoomIt's derived or configured Ctrl+Alt hotkeys swallow characters typed with AltGr; upstream PR 51383 now targets those collisions.
known_information: French AltGr+5 and German/Nordic bracket-entry scenarios are documented with screenshots and later confirmations.
Keyboard Manager remapping and disabling the relevant ZoomIt feature are reported workarounds.
The direct upstream fix is open, not merged; historical fork design issue 647 remains publicly accessible.
inferences: The current implementation proposal may avoid the reported character collisions without the risk of replacing the complete hotkey subsystem.
issue_context.analysis: Fresh linked implementation evidence supersedes the old green-confidence hook replacement. No new independent design convergence or E2E validation is claimed.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, all comments, current metadata, and cross-reference timeline.
Read PR 51383's implementation description, affected files, layout tests, and stated compatibility trade-offs.
Revalidated the historical public fork design issue's identity and open state.
